cause_quote: The dashboard gallery introduced `.some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query))`, which leaves composed and decomposed Unicode unequal.
user_saw: Searching Settings, Usage conversations, or the dashboard gallery could hide a matching result when the query and stored text used different Unicode forms of the same characters.
summary: The fix applies NFC normalization to both sides of local text and tag comparisons in Settings, Usage conversations, and the dashboard gallery.
reasoning: The cited commit introduced dashboard gallery search with the faulty comparison, and the Settings search introduction in f69219f7682308822f30cfb1f4f5f20b3660d50d independently shipped the same omission in its text and tag matching. The Usage comparison already had the omission before the July UI architecture refactor, but the available offline history could not establish its introducing commit.
